caption: AI can help plan your week, but you need guardrails. These prompts guide diagnosing priorities, improving methods, applying a weekly plan, checking constraints, and refining with feedback. Save for weekly use. What constraint would you add to your AI plan first? #AIforWork #Productivity #Prioritization #Entrepreneurship

slides.title: Don't Let AI Pick Priorities
slides.body: Your AI plan misses urgency. Here are five prompts to diagnose, improve, apply, check, and refine.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose Priorities
slides.body: Prompt 1: Diagnose priorities. Task: summarize <WEEK_TASKS> with deadlines and impact. Output: numbered list with urgency tags.

slides.title: 2. Improve Method
slides.body: Prompt 2: Improve method. Propose a prioritization framework (RICE or MoSCoW). Placeholder: <BUSINESS_GOALS>. Output: framework steps and a mapping table.

slides.title: 3. Apply Plan to Week
slides.body: Prompt 3: Apply a week plan. Given <WEEK_TASKS>, assign priority scores using the framework and suggest time estimates.

slides.title: 4. Check Alignment
slides.body: Prompt 4: Check constraints. Verify plan aligns with <BUDGET>, <ENERGY_LIMIT>, and <DEADLINES>. Output: checklist of gaps.

slides.title: 5. Refine with Feedback
slides.body: Prompt 5: Refine plan. After <REVIEW_COMMENTS>, adjust priorities by constraints and remove non-essentials. Output: revised list.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Use guardrails, then review weekly; this keeps AI from stealing your priorities.
